_comment: Comeback campaign seed — 4 points tasks bound to campaignId comeback-2026. Points only: bountyUsdc here is a POINTS value (0-10), never money (seed/route.ts validPoints). Cash reaches people through the campaign UNLOCK ($2 per Orb-verified human, pot 40), not through these tasks. Fire with: scripts/seed-comeback.sh

tasks.description: Photograph wherever you are right now — street, desk, window, anything real
Photograph one small good thing you did today
Rate one local place honestly — the real verdict, not the polite one
Tell us the one thing FAVOUR should build next (points only, and we read every one)
